item.title: How to enable source maps in Angular
item.description: Enabling source maps allows you to debug production Angular applications by mapping minified code back to the original TypeScript source. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve debugged countless production issues using source maps. The most effective solution is to configure source maps in angular.json for different build configurations. This approach enables debugging without exposing unminified code to end users.
